text: Current newFolderDialog registers the input handler and reevaluates acceptance after folder selection. doEnabling disables the button for an empty name, no selected parent or an existing same-name child. This is newer than the landing-era input-only closure. Keep the named handler and both inputs when changing dialog state; dialog accept invokes the async callback without awaiting it, so closing the dialog is not completion of metadata inheritance. These are fixed accepted source and test-code observations. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint, live accessibility or crypto/TLS validation ran.
title: Keep new-folder dialog enablement tied to name and parent selection
